Reviewed #4633 (034ac51c). Parser split (DO-routine vs literal-action path) looks correct and precedence-preserving. Runtime concern in prg_engine.cpp ~9925-9950: every dispatch of a literal-action bar generates a brand-new uniquely-named synthetic routine (__copperfin_popup_action_<instance>_<next_popup_action_id++>) and inserts it into source_program.routines, which lives in the session-lifetime `programs` cache (load_program never evicts). Not blocking if #4633 is already closed, but flagging before more slices build on this pattern.

Reviewed b1fa71d0. Root-cause fix is exactly right: Application.SetUnhandledExceptionMode(ThrowException) before EnableVisualStyles/Application.Run.
